name: GhazalBench
description: Persian poetry plays an active role in Iranian cultural practice, where verses by canonical poets such as Hafez are frequently quoted, paraphrased, or completed from partial cues. Supporting such interactions requires language models to engage not only with poetic meaning but also with culturally canonical surface form. We introduce GhazalBench, a benchmark for evaluating how large language models (LLMs) interact with Persian ghazals under usage-grounded conditions.
